profile_text.body:
Cognigy is a Düsseldorf, Germany company whose website presents it as NiCE Cognigy, an enterprise customer service AI offering. The site says it powers enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat, and invites visitors to get a demo or try it free. It also describes deploying AI agents in a contact center to deliver fast, personalized service.

The product tracked for the company is Cognigy itself, listed under Enterprise AI Platforms and Agent Orchestration and described as a conversational AI platform for customer service that is GDPR-compliant and offers EU-hosted options.

A Delaware law exposure entry is recorded with a count of 33. No lawsuits and no MCP servers are recorded.
